raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fixes #61078 by completing the API key authentication limitations list in `docs/usage/security.md`. The documentation now names the three endpoint groups that bypass the guarded `/v1`, `/v2`, `/inference`, and `/cohere` prefixes.

## Claims

- Document `/metrics` and `/kv_event_sources` as unauthenticated utility endpoints, including the information they expose.
- Document `/fault_tolerance/apply` and `/fault_tolerance/status` when fault tolerance is enabled.
- Keep the change documentation-only; endpoint authentication behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

- `uvx pre-commit run --files docs/usage/security.md` — passed (including markdownlint-cli2, typos, configuration validation, and repository instruction checks).
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Confirmed the current middleware guards only `/v1`, `/v2`, `/inference`, and `/cohere`, and verified the three route registrations in the serving code.
- Model evaluation: not applicable; this change only documents existing endpoint behavior.

## Details

The duplicate-work checks for issue #61078 and the related endpoint keywords found no open PR addressing this documentation gap. The issue author explicitly offered the documentation-only path. The entries include feature-availability conditions so operators can map the documented exposure to their deployment configuration.

AI assistance was used for repository inspection, wording, and validation. I reviewed every changed line and the referenced route and middleware code.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill.
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** The change is limited to the security guide and documents the existing authentication boundary.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** The changed Markdown passed the repository pre-commit checks and the route/middleware behavior was verified from source.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** The entries match the existing endpoint grouping and wording style.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** The issue, non-duplication check, validation, and scope are documented above.
</details>

detail.title: [Docs] List additional unauthenticated endpoints

files.patch:
@@ -208,9 +208,13 @@ The following endpoints **do not require authentication** even when `--api-key`
 - `/update_weights` - Update model weights (can alter model behavior)
 - `/get_world_size` - Get distributed world size
 - `/abort_requests` - Abort in-flight requests (available with `--tokens-only`. Use the authenticated `/inference/v1/abort_requests` otherwise)
+- `/fault_tolerance/apply` - Trigger fault-recovery operations across ranks (available when fault tolerance is enabled)
+- `/fault_tolerance/status` - Query fault-recovery status (available when fault tolerance is enabled)
 
 **Utility endpoints:**
 
+- `/metrics` - Prometheus metrics, including model, throughput, queue, and KV-cache statistics
+- `/kv_event_sources` - KV-event publisher configuration for each data-parallel rank, which may reveal internal transport endpoints (when KV events are configured)
 - `/tokenize` - Tokenize text (not gated by `--enable-scale-out`)
 - `/detokenize` - Detokenize tokens
 - `/health` - Health check
